ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal distribution with approximately 92% low-intensity pixels (dark grey/black) and 8% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) forming focal points and one contiguous patch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity field across the majority of the fluke. A high-contrast, contiguous light-grey/white patch is located at the proximal-medial section of the left lobe. Distributed white pixel points (speckles) are non-uniformly scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 82 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Variable topography; left lobe features a prominent, deep traumatic indentation (missing segment) at the mid-point of the trailing edge. Right lobe shows a more regular series of low-amplitude serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the outer edges of both lobes, sweeping upward to acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of high-contrast white circular pixel clusters, ranging from 2-10 pixels in diameter, resembling barnacle scars across the central regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertically-oriented linear pixel disruptions visible on the medial portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent depigmentation patch on the lower medial left lobe; distinct structural notch/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-frequency white speckling across the dark pigmentation background.
